title: Random Glow
description: Random glow, the random glow look, is unmotivated orbs and analog leaks: a frame haunted by lamps that will not sit still. Optical accidents as style: even diffusion is the failure.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Dreams, nightlife, a memory with bad film: some orbs, some clean skin, a face still in the clear. Motivated lighting is the opposite discipline.
A surgical drama should not glow at random. It is the wrong tool when every lamp is explained, and the wrong tool when the whole frame floods and the subject dies.
Random means uneven.

blocks.text: Lock off, 35mm to 50mm. Face in the clear.
Irregular blooms, colored orbs, analog leak, not full-frame wash. Prompt: Random glow on [Subject], unmotivated orbs and analog leaks, a frame haunted by lamps.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: Even diffusion, or a flood that deletes the face. The tell is uniform glow.
Fix it: uneven orbs, leaks, some clean skin, subject still readable.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Random Glow in film?
Unmotivated orbs and analog leaks kept as style. The frame is haunted by lamps. Even, pretty diffusion is not the look.
Random Glow vs Light Leak
A light leak is a specific unexposed edge or flare of stock. Random glow may include leaks plus orbs that have no practical. If every bloom has a lamp, you wanted motivated light, not this.
When should I use Random Glow?
Dreams, nightlife, analog-horror memory. Skip surgical coverage and even diffusion.
How do I prompt Random Glow for AI image or video?
Hold the face, then: Random glow on [Subject], unmotivated orbs and analog leaks, a frame haunted by lamps. Demand uneven blooms and some clean skin.
